title: Your AI’s Secret Thoughts Were Never Actually Secret #ai #programming
transcript: Your AI’s Secret Thoughts Were Never Actually Secret #ai #programming

top_comments.author: @MrJasbur1
top_comments.text: Also, what about old school chain of thought prompting?  If I just ask a model a series of simple questions at a time rather than the big question I want all at once, I would know what the chain of thought is because I had a hand in guiding it, right?

top_reply.author: @Smiling.Schopenhauer
top_reply.text: This is specifically about the thinking traces inside <think> or equivalent. You cannot even disable reasoning in some models.

top_comments.author: @tom.2900
top_comments.text: Well... What was in the reasoning trace? That's the important fking bit. We know jailbreaking is possible already.

top_reply.author: @huzbum
top_reply.text:
You can start a conversation with super-duper Fable, then resume the conversation on weak sauce Haiku, and get Haiku to reveal the thinking traces from the earlier conversation.

The reason we care is because the reasoning is supposedly the secret sauce that makes the SOTA models so valuable.  That's why they started hiding it so the Chinese labs can't use it as training data.

top_comments.author: @MrJasbur1
top_comments.text: I wonder if the smaller model could also be talked into just giving up the decryption key.  Then a person could just do the decryption directly

top_reply.author: @Slada1
top_reply.text: It doesn't have access to that key, it is decrypted before handling it to that model

top_comments.author: @leonvolq6179
top_comments.text: Sounds like a very dumb AI wrote this + a human TTS that doesn't understand what he's talking about

top_comments.author: @kill92ify
top_comments.text: I mean couldn't they just not give the thinking through the API reference some sort of arbitrary key define that sessions thinking

top_reply.author: @TechnologicNick
top_reply.text: Even if they move sessions completely to the server, you would still be able to use this trick to leak the hidden reasoning tokens.
